subject: AWS Marketplace private offer — pilot pricing window & procurement ask
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@mediform.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace private offer — pilot pricing window & procurement ask

Hi Jamie,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — quick note to capture the next steps for the pilot private offer we discussed. High level: Mediform wants a 6-month pilot on the AWS Marketplace private offer with usage-based billing, early-volume discount, and minimal procurement friction so Cloud and Procurement can sign-off quickly.

To keep momentum we propose:
- Create an AWS private offer that maps to a short-term pilot (6 months), with a 25% list discount on usage for the first 3 months.
- Include an activation clause that transitions to a 12-month rolling term unless Mediform opts out at month 6.
- Provide the SOC2 Type II report and a one-page evidence pack for procurement.
- Assign a single activation owner in finance to avoid split approvals.

Attached: proposed quote workbook and SOC2 stub.

Would you loop Jordan (Cloud lead) and Rachel (procurement) on the specific approval timeline? If procurement can confirm the buyer-signoff window this week we can submit the private offer to AWS and route DocuSign for signature next week.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Strategic Account Exec | Redwood Inference
Email: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-private-offer-quote.xlsx (xlsx), SOC2_Type2_Redwood.pdf (pdf)
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@mediform.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jordan Lin <jordan.lin@mediform.com>, Rachel Brooks <procure@mediform.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer — pilot pricing window & procurement ask

Vivek — thanks, this captures the conversation. A few clarifying Qs from our side:

1) Buyer approval: Procurement will need confirmation that the private offer will be activated by an authorized buyer (we usually need CFO or delegated approver). Who at Redwood will be the activation owner on the PO?
2) Billing terms: Can you confirm whether usage will be invoiced monthly via AWS billing or Redwood will invoice Mediform directly during the pilot?
3) Evidence pack: SOC2 is required; do you have encryption/key mgmt evidence and a short on-data-retention policy we can include?

Jordan and I are aligned on the 6-month pilot; procurement will need the exact window (start/end dates) to run against our budget quarter. If you can send a one-page MAP and the invoice flow, Rachel will prioritize the review.

—Jamie
Head of Cloud Platforms | Mediform Health
jamie.park@mediform.com | +1 (617) 555-4621

Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer — pilot pricing window & procurement ask

Hi Rachel / Jamie — looping in here from operations to make the approval path explicit and reduce back-and-forth. Quick answers below and an ask for the buyer owner.

1) Activation owner: Redwood will designate a single activation contact — I will be the activation owner for the pilot and will coordinate with your buyer. For AWS private offers, the buyer (Mediform) must be the purchaser via their AWS account; we will not invoice directly during the marketplace pilot.

2) Billing flow: usage will be billed through AWS Marketplace to Mediform’s AWS account. That means financial activation is performed in AWS and you should see charges on your AWS invoice. We can provide an activation guide and an itemized charge forecast for finance.

3) Evidence pack: attaching the SOC2 Type II (redacted) and a short data retention + key management FAQ you requested. Also attaching the one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that captures start/end dates and success criteria.

Action items for Mediform:
- Please confirm the authorized buyer (name & email) who will accept the private offer in your AWS console.
- Confirm preferred pilot start date window (we recommended: 2027-06-01 to 2027-11-30).

If procurement confirms the buyer this afternoon we’ll prepare the AWS private offer and share the DocuSign.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Business Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0199 | tessa_morgan@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_Mediform_v1.docx (docx), DataRetention_KMS_FAQ.txt (txt), SOC2_Type2_Redwood.pdf (pdf)
From: Rachel Brooks <procure@mediform.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie.park@mediform.com>, Jordan Lin <jordan.lin@mediform.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer — pilot pricing window & procurement ask

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the clear MAP. Procurement confirms the authorized buyer for our AWS account will be: Jordan Lin <jordan.lin@mediform.com> (delegated by CFO). Jordan will accept the private offer in the AWS console.

Couple of notes from procurement review:
- Term & auto-transition: Procurement prefers pilot to be explicit with no automatic transition. If you can make the offer expire on 2027-11-30 and allow a 30-day renewal window (i.e., manual opt-in), that reduces legal friction.
- Billing: because charges will show on our AWS invoice, finance needs an itemized usage forecast. Can you provide a 3-month forecast by service (tokens / compute) and a capped estimate for the pilot?
- Evidence: SOC2 doc is fine; would like a short attestation on data residency (we require US-only hosting for this pilot).

If Redwood can revise the private offer to be expire-on and share the usage forecast + residency attestation by end of day Monday 5/23, procurement will fast-track review.

Rachel Brooks
Senior Procurement Manager | Mediform Health
procure@mediform.com | +1 (212) 555-9012

Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer — pilot pricing window & procurement ask

Rachel — thanks, we can do that. Quick summary of changes and attachments delivered: 

- Offer expiration: private offer will be created with an explicit expiration date of 2027-11-30 and no automatic roll into a 12-month term. We will include a 30-day renewal window and an option for Mediform to request conversion to annual pricing.
- Usage forecast: attached a 3-month itemized usage forecast (tokens, GPU hours, estimated spend) — conservative caps included.
- Data residency attestation: Redwood confirms US-only hosting for workloads in this private offer; attestation signed by our security lead attached.

Next steps (short checklist):
1) Jordan to accept private offer in AWS console once we share the offer link (we will submit to AWS once you confirm acceptance owner).
2) Mediform to review Docusign (we will send a short activation acknowledgment — not a contract rewrite).
3) Redwood will enable monitoring hooks in the console so your Cloud team can observe initial usage.

Attachments: redwood-private-offer-quote.xlsx (xlsx), UsageForecast_Q3_pilot.xlsx (xlsx), DataResidency_Attestation.pdf (pdf)

I'll submit to AWS early next week once Jordan confirms. Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if helpful.

Best,
Tessa
Business Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
